resources.string: Settings
Privacy settings
Setup
Restore
Dak personal data export

This file contains the data the Dak app stored about you on your phone, as plain JSON.
It is NOT encrypted: anyone with this file can read it. Keep it somewhere safe and delete it when you are done.

manifest.json lists every file with its size, SHA-256 checksum and a short description.
data/*.json files hold one JSON document each; data/*.jsonl files hold one JSON object per line.
Times are milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC.

Not included: your SMS and MMS messages (use Settings > Backup, data and privacy > Export for those),
secrets such as keys and PINs, and data Dak can rebuild from your messages.

Questions: see the privacy policy in the app (Settings > Privacy > Privacy policy).
Your SMS and MMS messages themselves: they live in the phone\'s shared message store. Use Backup → Export to save them.
Keys and secrets: the index key, the backup passphrase and recovery code, the app-lock PIN and webhook secrets.
Data Dak can rebuild: the search index and installed-app OTP hashes.
Your Dak settings (only values you changed).
How you grouped senders, and names you gave them.
Labels you or your rules put on messages, by message key (for example sms:123).
Each time you allowed, declined or withdrew a feature that sends data off the phone.
Your automation rules (the rule definition is the \"json\" column).
What each rule sent, failed to send or skipped, and where to.
Automatic and destructive actions (rules firing, auto-deletes, restores).
Messages you scheduled, including sent and cancelled ones.
Searches you saved.
Your recent searches.
Bank accounts and cards in the Passbook, with balances.
Transactions Dak found in your messages.
Accounts you merged or kept apart.
Account types you set by hand.
Accounts you removed from the Passbook.
Per-conversation choices: pinned, muted, archived, reply SIM, colour.
Sender groups and the names shown for them.
Which addresses belong to which sender group.
Messages you starred or archived.
The category and labels Dak gave each message (no message text).
Messages in the recycle bin (deleted, waiting to be purged). Includes their text.
National Cyber Crime Helpline
Lost money to online or UPI fraud? Call immediately: reporting within the first hours gives the best chance of freezing the money.
National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
File a complaint about financial fraud or any other cyber crime online, and track it.
Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi)
Report suspected fraud calls, SMS or WhatsApp messages (fake KYC, impersonation, fake customer care) to the Department of Telecommunications.
TRAI spam complaint (1909)
Report unsolicited commercial SMS (spam) to your operator under TRAI\'s rules. Send the message text, the sender and the date.
TRAI DND and spam complaints (call 1909)
Call your operator\'s 1909 line to register a spam complaint or change your Do Not Disturb preferences.
Emergency (112)
Police, fire, ambulance: India\'s single emergency number.
RBI Complaint Management System
Complain to the RBI Ombudsman when your bank, card issuer or payment app hasn\'t resolved your complaint.
RBI Contact Centre (14448)
Help with filing a complaint against a bank or payment company with the RBI.
RBI Sachet
Report companies illegally collecting deposits or running unregulated investment schemes.
